Whether the change passes any test is unknown: no test log was supplied.
statements.resolution: Run the project test suite on the change and attach the log with its exit status.

next_action.action: Send the two critical findings to the engineering path as a repair card; re-review the new diff.

intent.text: Add a nightly export of the billing rota to a gzip file for the support lead; no other behaviour changes.

missing_requirements: No test covers the export or the gzip step.

findings.title: Team name reaches a shell command
findings.problem: The output path contains the --team value and is interpolated into a shell=True command, so a team name such as 'x; rm -rf ~' runs as shell.
findings.recommendation: Call gzip with an argument list and no shell, or compress in Python with the gzip module; validate the team name against the known teams.
siblings: no other subprocess call in the diff

findings.title: Every run deletes all earlier exports
findings.problem: rmtree on the export directory runs before each export, so last night's file and any other team's export are deleted.
findings.recommendation: Write into the directory without deleting it; if old files must go, remove only this team's files older than a stated retention.

findings.title: Export date uses server local time
findings.problem: A naive datetime.now() names the file by the server's local date; a run near midnight on a UTC server would carry the wrong Berlin date.
findings.recommendation: Use the rota's time zone explicitly when naming the file.

findings.title: No test for the export
findings.problem: The diff adds an export path with file writes and a subprocess but no test; the deletion above would have been caught by one.
findings.recommendation: Add a test that runs two exports for two teams into a temporary directory and checks both files remain.

options.label: Delete this team's exports older than 30 days

decisions.why: Bounded disk use without deleting other teams' files.
